notes.title: New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱
notes.notes:
New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/900669231e9d1a8697f36ce5ed6de4cb969eb7a3.png"][/img]

[h2][b]New DLCs And Free Update - Available Now! 🌱[/b][/h2]

We’re excited to finally share all the new features we’ve been working on for the past few months. We couldn’t be more excited for you to experience it 🤩

And what’s more, [b]the main game and Digital Supporter Pack are available at a 40% discount, while new DLCs are 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale![/b] No matter if you’re jumping back in or starting fresh, it’s the perfect time to explore all the new content and see how far your medieval world can grow.

Watch the official trailer to see what's coming to Medieval Dynasty
[previewyoutube=4R7uDhe-Dus;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Plant a Tree Update[/b][/h3]

Medieval Dynasty receives new content with the release of the [b]free Plant a Tree update.[/b] This long-requested update brings two major features: the ability to plant trees, using seedlings gathered while chopping wood, and the option to move freely various constructions with your hammer’s new Move Mode. You also get the improved audio, new UI sounds, and various fixes and updates that enhance the overall experience.[/p][p]For the detailed list of what changes, see the changelog below.

[h3][b]Echoes of Nature DLC[/b][/h3]

Alongside the update, we’re excited to introduce the [b]very first DLC for Medieval Dynasty – Echoes of Nature.[/b] If you’re looking to add more charm and detail to your world, this DLC lets you create beautiful gardens and decorate the alleys and front yards of buildings throughout your village.[/p][p]It adds a wide variety of new outdoor decorations, including trees, shrubs, hedges, stone elements, and more — all designed to blend naturally with your surroundings and respond to the changing seasons. It’s the perfect way to bring more life and beauty to your settlement.

See the list below for the exact list of new features:

[b]🌱 Shrubs[/b]
[list]
[*] Green Shrub
[*] Wild Rose Bush
[*] Yellow Flowering Shrub
[*] White Flowering Shrub
[/list]
[b]🌱 Other Trees[/b]
[list]
[*] Small Evergreen A
[*] Small Evergreen B
[*] Majestic Tree
[/list]
[b]🌱 Rocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Flat Rock
[*] Tall Rock
[*] Wide Rock
[*] Balancing Rock
[/list]
[b]🌱 Ponds[/b]
[list]
[*] Round Pond
[*] Rockery Pond
[/list]
[b]🌱 Fences[/b]
[list]
[*] Low Hedge
[*] Tall Hedge
[/list]
[h3][b]Medieval Dynasty Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b][/h3]

[b]Medieval Dynasty Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b] is the second DLC created with all the music fans in mind. Now, you are able to access compositions that haven’t been available outside the game. This DLC serves as a complement to the soundtrack previously available with the Digital Supporter Pack.
It features 39 tracks, equalling over 2 hours of immersive music across 3 themed albums:

[list]
[*] Disc 1 – Three Bards Album 
Six cheerful, festive songs performed by the band Three Bards, inspired by troubadour music
[*] Disc 2 – Special Themes Album 
16 tracks that build the game world’s atmosphere – from the main theme to the character creator music, as well as themes for villages and important NPCs
[*] Disc 3 – Gameplay Music Album
17 compositions created for exploration and combat
[/list]
The soundtrack is available for PC platforms (Steam, Epic, GOG), but you can listen to it also using streaming services like Spotify or Apple Music!

[h3][b]Digital Supporter Pack[/b][/h3]

On top of all that, [b]we’re also updating the Digital Supporter Pack[/b] with some fun and fresh content. You’ll get access to a new game save file, perfect for co-op adventures. This save includes several well-known board games reimagined in the world of Medieval Dynasty! Don’t have a die? No worries — we’ve added a special new command to roll one in-game. Full instructions are included in the save file.[

Additionally, we’ve added a set of beautiful new wallpapers showing the stunning natural landscapes of the game. Perfect for the summer season. 
If you already own the Digital Supporter Pack, you can download all the new content for free.

[h3][b]Plant a Tree Update Changelog[/b][/h3]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Possibility to plant Trees/shrubs/bushes. The tree seedlings will grow into full trees after 4 seasons, can be cut and will regrow from stumps after 8 seasons
[*] Intel® XeSS 2 (Super Resolution, Frame Generation, Low Latency) support
[*] ]New hammer mode allowing to move buildings, furnitures, gates, and platforms
[*] Armour sounds for player animations while working at Well, Woodshed, Kitchen, Herbalist's Hut, Barn, Smithy, Sewing Hut, Workshop, and Windmill
[*] Sound notification for broken: equipped armour and holdable items in use
[*] Sound of throwing away broken armour and clothes from the inventory
[*] UI sounds for dyeing clothes in the inventory – separate sounds for Dyes and Decolouriser
[*] Klonica, and Hornica Day Theme (soundtrack) – new version
[*] Player's ragdoll sounds for grass surfaces
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Items not always taking into account condition of resources and the "Stolen" status during fast crafting
[*] Event White Spring in seasons other than spring
[*] Rapidly placing fences as a client resulting in numerous bugs
[*] Toggle armour visibility not working with keyboard/gamepad-[*] Player losing access to some of the items when closing "People demand control" tab while changing item priority
[*] Items removed from inventory list when player was trying to transfer them to a full container
[*] Items moved to the container didn't refresh UI 
[*] Crafting many items at once (wtih Fast Crafting option) caused all crafted items to have the same condition
[*] Stolen Buckets and Waterskins once filled with water stopped being marked as stolen
[*] Collision with items when placing a Training Dummy
[*] Arrows spawned through POIs or by dropping from inventory despawned on season change
[*] Player could be killed during loading screen
[*] Inventory scrolling on host when someone is crafting using remote storage
[*] Player bartering skill not affecting prices for horses
[*] Resources gathered from field not going into farm shed storage if there is no food storage
[*] Health restore amount not depending on the time slept
[*] Player equipping torch if accetping a notice board quest
[*] Player camera going crazy after entering photo mode when player character is drunk
[*] Client playing on gamepad can't place platforms

[*] An emptied container being transferred from player items to storage during crafting with remote storages option
[*] Host not seeing modules of a building if a client wanted to upgrade it but decided not to
[*] Music not changing during gameplay

[/list]
[b]Updated[/b]

notes.title: Patch 2.3.0.9 on the Test Branch
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
We share with you [b]update 2.3.0.9[/b] which which will resolve some of the problems releated to the recent release:

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Some disconnect issues related to inventory replication if player or storages stored many different items
[*]  Infants despawning instantly for clients if mother was sitting on a mount during birth
[*] The UI input was not updated on the client when switching between rotation and height in the building mode
[*] After loading the game with 0 food/water, the HUD showed the food/water bar as full
[*] Mount inventory state for client not showing correctly in various cases
[/list]
[b]To access the test branch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right click Medieval Dynasty in your Steam library and pick 'properties'
[*] Then go to 'Betas' on the left side and under Beta participation, select "public_testing"
[*] As soon as you do this Steam should have an update queued for MD and can start downloading the version on the test branch.
[*] If you want to download the live version again (public branch), just change the Beta participation back to "None" like it originally was.
[/list]
As always, this version can contain unexpected bugs. If you are bothered by this, just stay on the live version and wait a couple of days til we roll out the test version.

To be safe, take a backup of your savegame before playing the test version.
You can find your savegame in %LocalAppData%\Medieval_Dynasty\Saved\SaveGames.

Keep in mind that to be able to play co-op, all players must be on the same version. So if you are on the test version, you will not be able to crossplay with other platforms, and all Steam players must download the test version as well.

Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

notes.title: Paint Your Town Update - Out Now! 🎨😄
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/653af56dcb97956b618228d4b21667f8d6c04d2d.png[/img]
[h2]Ready to paint your town?🎨😄[/h2]

After decorating your village with crests, we take it one step further and introduce an [b]update 2.3.0.0[/b] that, among other features, allows you to add some colour and patterns to your walls.

But that’s not all!

Other new features include, but are not limited to: 
[list]
[*] the economy tab, 
[*] remote storage, 
[*] “take all” option. 
[/list]
We also fixed problems such as animals leaving their pens. As always, a number of updates were introduced, e.g., item prices now take into account their condition, building costs are now visible in the crafting menu, and more.

Read the complete [b]update 2.3.0.0 changelog[/b] and see everything it adds, fixes, and updates:

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Remote Storages - A player can use resources from remote storages when crafting/building while within their range. The maximum range increases with the level of the storage. This also works for a chest in the building where the player is crafting. 
[*] Economy summary tab - contains data from different time periods on items created and consumed in the village
[*] Painting the walls of buildings with colours and patterns
[*] House presets with sticks / logs / stones
[*] Item stacks with different conditions
[*] Option to take all items from containers and bandit corpses
[*] Memorial Stone on the Oxbow map
[*] New hit and swipe sounds for battle axe
[*] Sounds of hitting snow, fabric, armour with: iron axe, stone axe, fists, iron hammer
[*] New footsteps sounds for NPCs and players - metal armour
[*] Season switch sounds (different sounds for each season)
[*] Projectiles spawning particles when breaking
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Husbandry animals leaving their pens
[*] The map opening with the player marker in the centre
[*] Centering on a player on a map
[*] Inability to turn in side quests to Derwan during main story while on a horse
[*] Broken vase given as a quest reward
[*] Wrong bucket counting for event restrictions
[*] Fixed reward for quest Flowertelling
[*] Fixed weight of simple torch 
[*] Events not taking storages into account
[*] Some events
[*] Head shape of a player resetting after loading the game
[*] Character's ears sticking closely to the head even if the helmet's visibility is turned off
[*] Wrong character hair variant if a barber was visited while wearing a helmet with turned off visibility
[*] Melee weapons not having any reverb inside buildings and caves
[*] Range weapons getting stuck preventing bandits from shooting
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can hide unavailable items in People's Demand Control tab in Management
[*] Buildings costs are now visible in crafting menu
[*] Item prices now take into account their condition
[*] The total animal feed demand is now visible in the building details
[*] Number of dye slots is now visible in the item description
[*] Less poison reduction: Cherry Wine
[*] Higher productivity: Bucket with Milk
[*] Changed technology gain from crafting most items
[*] Changed experience gain from crafting most items
[*] Changed availability from Vendors: Knives, Sickles, Scythes, Scissors, Shovels, Hand Lantern, Pouches, Backpacks, Saddlebags, Spears, Bows, Crossbows
[*] Reduced temperature of the hottest summer weather
[*] Women with infants go for a walk outside their house
[*] Building walls colorations for story villages 
[*] Mixed special audio effects: stagger and block break
[*] New sounds of sword hitting snow
[*] Slight network optimizations for Fields and Orchards
[*] Reduced memory usage when a great number of NPCs is present
[*] Tweaked projectile hit effects
[*] All Languages updated
[*] Skill Handyman has been removed. From now on, everyone can insulate their homes.
[*] Instead of the Handyman skill, there will be a Full Focus skill which removes stamina consumption from Inspector Mode
[/list]
Kind regards
Render Cube and Toplitz teams

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129580/Medieval_Dynasty/

Dear Players,

After receiving reports about the game unexpectedly crashing, we released a patch which will resolve this problem. As for now, you can access it on the test branch. We are constantly working on fixing other problems that appeared, thus the next patch, which will be released later on the public branch, will solve more of the reported issues.

[b]How to use steam branch[/b]
1. To add a branch, right-click on Medieval Dynasty in your Steam Library 
2. Choose the Properties option in the drop-down menu
3. In the Properties window, select the “Betas” Tab
4. Enter the Beta Test Code in ”Private Betas” window 
5. When you access the branch, you can select one of the following branches:

[b]Public_testing:[/b]
This is a version of the game that has early access to the new updates and patches before they are released on the public branch.

notes.title: What is going on with the update?
notes.notes:
[h2][b]What is going on with the update?[/b][/h2]

We are asked this question daily in emails, direct messages, and comments, so we want to answer you all in this post.

[b]The update is coming[/b], and it is coming soon.

We work hard every day to provide enjoyable gameplay for players across every platform. It makes us sad to hear that some of our players feel abandoned or forgotten. Our primary concern for the past few months has been to prepare the update for console players, and not only them.

We understand the frustration, as we are equally excited about the release as our community is, but we also acknowledge that the lack of official communication from our side has caused more doubt around the update, and we want to apologise for that.

Very soon we will reveal more specific information about the update which not only will bring awaited co-op mode for consoles but also many surprises for the rest of our amazing players. We are working on the next step marked on our roadmap and we are looking forward to moving further to the new content which will enrich the gameplay.

Kind regards,
Render Cube Team

notes.title: Update to v.1.5.1.2 - PUBLIC STAGE ! Updated!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Elders!

Have you already missed the Public Stage? Well, we have a new update for it featuring some new additions, fixes, and plenty of upgrades.

New is the photo mode!

In a nutshell, you must be in the 3PV, then you can call up the photo mode. Here you can make settings just like on a camera. Rotate the camera, adjust the lens, brightness, saturation (black and white images!), exposure or colour effects. Have fun experimenting.

Also new are the QoL feature "Quick Build" and many new audio effects.

Now it's your turn!

[h3] How to join the public staging? [/h3]
Some of you probably have not done this before, so here is a small guide:

[b] Prerequisite: [/b]
You must have Medieval Dynasty in your library – obviously.

[b]The procedure[/b]
[list]
[*] Open your game library.
[*] Right Click on Medieval Dynasty there.

[*] Open properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/248a195d609cae5f11facbaedcc7418ebb41af1b.jpg[/img]

[*] Enter this password below the dropdown in the field:

[b]MedievalStaging[/b]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/c3ed25e14098e8e518f670587116014f67e095fa.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Press CHECK CODE
[*] Use the drop down and select “release_build_staging”. This is the public stage.
[*] Press Close

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/c55cded05f6b72de0122b5336bc0d38a09f7399f.jpg[/img]

[*] Footstep sounds for a Dolby Atmos setup.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Sickle of contention and Rajmunds cane can be equipped in quickslots.
[*] After removing furniture in the tavern, NPCs who were sitting on the bench sit mid-air.
[*] Poppy flowers in the field disappear with the distance.
[*] Hives in the apiary have an incorrect rotation.
[*] Sometimes NPCs can't get to the workbench and just stand idle.
[*] Quest-NPCs react to snowball hits.
[*] Traveling with waggoners is not available after the player kicks out a companion from the village in a "follow" quest.
[*] Bandits stay in place, not approaching or looking at the player.
[*] Astrid (special NPC) just died the day she turned 60.
[*] Herald or exotic goods vendor is in a town without a tavern.
[*] Possible fix for NPCs stuck halfway in the ground.
[*] Alwin's buggy questline.
[*] Family quests now don't use the Player's NPCs in them (apart from the family)
[*] Every time you drink a potable item with a capacity you have multiple stacks of you decrease the capacity from a different stack instead of the same one.
[*] No footstep sounds for a Girl.
[*] Wolf growling sounds while running are too frequent.
[*] Key binding buttons in the options don't react on mouse hover.
[*] Save and Load menu buttons don't react on mouse hover.
[*] In the options menu when a confirmation pops up, the inputs at the bottom are still clickable. 
[*] Version number is not blurred when the option confirmation pops up.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/38afb1f8ffa8671aa495fac9087cbf3fd967f259.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Memory usage optimisations.
[*] Rendering optimisations.
[*] Systems optimisations.
[*] Optimised NPCs.
[*] Tweaked NPCs movement.
[*] Optimised animals.
[*] Tweaked animal movement.
[*] Improved and optimized animal ragdolls.
[*] In an orchard, the middle section is cleared, not the entire area.
[*] Vegetation quality improvements.
[*] Increased "Craft More/Buy scheme" input.
[*] Numerous UI improvements (main menu, inputs, icons).
[*] New "on hover" behaviour in various menus.
[*] Sounds for changing weapons and tools.
[*] A lot of optimised and mixed audio.
[*] Increased the quality of many textures.
[*] Goose walking animation and speed.
[*] The crouching animation.
[*] Improvements for current dialogues and sounds.
[*] All languages updated.
[/list]

All points in [b]FIXED[/b] update v1.5.1.0

[/list]

[*] Mounts make stepping and neighing sounds while sleeping.
[*] Throwing rock and spear appearing in the player’s hands after throwing when the player entered photo mode at correct frame and unhid the character. [i](Fix for 1.5.1.1)[/i]
[*] Spear rotation resetting too early when pausing the game (making it hard to take a nice screenshot in photo mode). [i](Fix for 1.5.1.1)[/i]
[*] Drunk photo mode. [i](Fix for 1.5.1.1)[/i]
[*] Skeletal LoDs updating incorrectly when entering photo mode again without leaving the menu. [i](Fix for 1.5.1.1)[/i]
[*] Some skeletal LoDs not updating in photo mode. [i](Fix for 1.5.1.1)[/i]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Pop-up LODs of vegetation has been reduced.
[*] Changed min FoV value for photography camera to 30.
[/list]

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty – The Winter Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/c026fec2450fca700a8b373e8a971f39e761b19d.png[/img]

Hello, village elders!

Today’s winter update concludes this year’s update spree. Don’t worry: We’ll continue with updates in 2023!

This update has a bit of everything: sound, quality of life updates, new furniture and so on. We also threw in a chunk of fixes.

See the notes below for more info and for now, we wish you all fantastic holidays and a happy new year!

The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions

[previewyoutube=9y6rmFaShFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad5a520ff892afe53d94d369ed41191b6caac6ef.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Horse and donkey fall if they hit the ground hard enough.
[*] Sounds for many items to pick up from the ground.
[*] New building – Farm Shed (Employees work in the fields and orchards. Those in the barn don't do it anymore).
[*] New furniture – Composter.
[*] Five new furniture – Containers.
[*] Seven new wall decorations – Reliefs.
[*] New Gate – Plank Gate.
[*] New Fence – Plank Fence.
[*] It is possible to build the snowman in winter.
[*] It is possible to craft snowballs in winter.
[*] Over 20 new locations generated on the map.
[*] Aim Assist for controllers.
[*] New break animations for employees.
[*] NPCs reacting to getting bumped into.
[*] NPCs reacting to getting hit by a snowball.
[*] Horse can fall if it hits something at high velocity.
[*] Donkey can fall if it hits something at high velocity.
[*] Gameplay tips in loading screen.
[*] In some dialogues the ESC/Cancel button will result in exiting/going back in dialogue.
[*] New status indicating the number of problems with work in fields and orchards.
[*] Number of coins in possession visible during dialogue.
[*] Sounds for Player's Scythe and Sickle.
[*] Sounds for picking from fields and orchards (every vegetable and fruit has its unique picking sounds).
[*] All foliage types have their unique picking sounds (for example: there are different sounds for reed, stick, stone, broadleaf, mushroom, or sapling etc.).
[*] Sounds of eating: carrot, onion, and beetroot.
[*] Sounds for inspector mode.
[*] Sounds for wicker chests.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ce731c2491c0f2391442fc4636b5f8dca5f13368.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Animals launching into the air when killed on steep terrain.
[*] The Talk area marker on the compass is bugged when player is mounted.
[*] In the quest "Young Love" flowers stay in the inventory after talking to your son.
[*] Furniture from "Other" category can be built before getting permission to build on the land.
[*] Wrong item selected after removing whole stack.
[*] List in Builders Hut not updating when buildings get damaged by a tree.
[*] Disappearing items when loading a game save.
[*] Toddlers sneezing problem.
[*] Dough in cooking stove is not showing correctly in third person when ending crafting.
[*] If LMB was pressed before RMB for Throwable item, player had to release both buttons to be able to throw it again.
[*] Fixed fast traveller lantern sounds.
[*] Quests with building furniture may work incorrect in some situations.	
[*] Gates cannot be placed on permanent roads.	
[*] Some achievements didn't unlock properly.
[*] Player animation stuck when falling off a mount in some cases.
[*] Combat music not ending sometimes on season skip.
[*] Player being able to throw objects like snowballs with zero velocity resulting in projectiles falling down in a spawn location.
[*] Sometimes items disappear in animations.
[*] A possible fix for enabled animations on some workbenches when no NPC is nearby.
[*] Faded audio sometimes not returning on camera fade.
[*] Possible case of broken ambient audio transitions.
[*] Animals running sideways diminished.
[*] Sleeping for the family quest makes the bed inaccessible.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/38afb1f8ffa8671aa495fac9087cbf3fd967f259.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Memory usage optimizations.
[*] Increased the basic building limit by 5.
[*] Animals don't reproduce if they are hungry.
[*] Animal Inverse Kinematics improvements.
[*] Several animal walking/running speed adjustments.
[*] Improved falling off a mount.
[*] House decoration system (More slots).
[*] Improved the pathfinding on roads.
[*] House decoration menu now has categories for easier management.
[*] Small trees in orchards don't block characters.
[*] Assigning an NPC to a workplace now no longer requires selecting a profession (now every building has only one profession).
[*] Desired skill and profession added to building slot in NPC workplace selection.
[*] In the building details at the storage part now weight and coins are visible.
[*] Stage names for fields and orchards, suggesting next tasks.
[*] Several UI optimizations.
[*] Using unstuck button outside of map borders now should move player to starting location.
[*] Count of throwable weapons is now shown in HUD.
[*] Loudness level of music. Default value of music that we recommend is on 75% and all other sounds like SFX we recommend on 100%.
[*] Music Soundtracks are levelled to general loudness standards.
[*] All languages updated.
[*] Reputation decreases when hitting animals from NPC villages with snowballs.	
[*] Damage calculation when hitting tail bone in animals.
[*] Changed returning dialogue order when buying animal from locations, so that it's not required to return to the category each time the player buys something.	
[*] Changed the way coin prices are displayed in dialogues.	
[*] Darker colour of fertiliser in the fields.
[*] FOV blending alpha for rock/snowball, bow and spear.
[*] Throwing animation in TP is now quicker for Rock/Snowball.
[*] Roof textures.
[*] Construction progress in the ghost.
[*] Optimized NPCs.
[*] Horse sounds are less frequent.
[*] Mixed river sounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Fall Update!
notes.notes:
Hello village elders!

Brand new from the Public Stage comes our Fall Update for you! It contains many improvements and fixes and some new features. Have a look at the notes below to see what has changed.

But as the saying goes, before the update is after the update, and that's why we'll be diligently pursuing two more major updates planned on the roadmap.

What we are also looking forward to on this very day: Medieval Dynasty is also coming out on console today! Tell your console friends about it! Or gift them a copy for the next festive occasion! 😉

We hope you enjoy playing and we'll definitely catch up with you soon!

The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad5a520ff892afe53d94d369ed41191b6caac6ef.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Sounds of eating bread and soup.
[*] Trees can now deal damage when falling - friendly NPCs are safe.
[*] If the player falls from a certain height or gets hit by a tree he will get knocked out - if not, the fallen player will get up after 5 seconds.
[*] Player can get knocked down from a mount if hit by a falling tree or if the mount dies with player on
[*] Physics blending when the player is drunk above and beyond 80%.

[*] When holding the interaction button this interaction is going into a loop now, as if player was clicking constantly.

[*] Ambient sounds for cave: music ambient, water drops, and rocks drops. 
[*] Smooth transitions of attenuation of environmental sounds like winds, rains or birds depending on the type or levels of building / cave / or being underwater.

[*] Sounds of insects. There are 8 different insect species, divided into day / night and meadow / forest biomes.

notes.title: Son, you got a lot to tell! – The Heir Update
notes.notes:
Hello Village Elders!

The time has come! You hold in your hands: the Heir Update. 

Remember in the game? You have a house; you look at it and then ask if you could still extend it. 

We felt the same way, so we took the tools in our hands. We figuratively sawed, filed, sanded and, hammered - and the game got bigger and bigger.

Before the Heir update, Medieval Dynasty had about 75,000 words of text. That's roughly the equivalent of a 250-page book. Now we're close to 120,000 words of text. It took a while to manoeuvre this huge update into the valley, but it's finally here!

[previewyoutube=_xvRuV1X7CI;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think about the update! Tell us about your heir! As always, feel free to post below in the comments or on our social media channels.

Have fun playing and talk soon!


The teams of Render Cube and Toplitz Productions



[b]PS: Some languages are still work in progress and will be updated later![/b]

notes.title: Update to v.1.4.0.2. - PUBLIC STAGE – UPDATED!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Something happened in our Medieval Dynasty laboratory, we created monsters... text monsters. The Heir update is huge. No, it's massive. It took a while to usher them all down the narrow hamlets and paths to the village, but they're finally here!

Dear village elders, grab one of the exemplars (it just wants to play!) and find out what the heirs have to offer.

Currently the Public Stage is only available in English. However, all translations are currently in the works, and should be available for you soon.

Have fun with the Heirs update on the Public Stage.

[h3] How to join the public staging? [/h3]
Some of you probably have not done this before, so here is a small guide:

[b] Prerequisite: [/b]
You must have Medieval Dynasty in your library – obviously.

[b]The procedure[/b]
[list]
[*] Open your game library.
[*] Right Click on Medieval Dynasty there.

[*] Select the tab "BETAS".*
[*] Enter this password below the dropdown in the field:
MedievalStaging
[/list]

[list]
[*] Press CHECK CODE

[/list]

Hi everyone!

notes.title: The Calendar-Contest - Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

A quick update on the calendar contest!

1. We are extending the deadline for submitting screenshots by two more days, so the contest will end on 8 June 2022 at 23:59 CET.

2. We have received some wonderful pictures, but the HUD is in the image. Here's a hint: You can turn off the HUD with the keyboard shortcut "H".

3. You can save uncompressed images on Steam. To do this, select the "Steam" tab in the Steam client, then "Settings", then "In game" and tick "Save uncompressed copy". For this copy you should choose a separate folder because the screenshot will be saved two times.

4. You are invited to submit smaller image formats than the desired 4k. It is primarily about the pixel density, the resolution is important, but not everything. If necessary, a screenshot can be scaled up to 300 dpi in an image editor for printing.

Otherwise, all remains the same [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1129580/announcements/detail/3218396837686504079]as before[/url]!

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - The Windmill & Decorations Update
notes.notes:
Dear Elders!

Gather and behold the latest acquisition to the valley! A few resourceful heads from faraway places have stopped at the tavern and told the villagers about a machine that turns grain into flour by using the power of the wind. 

So now it's up to you to put their plans into action and build a miracle of modern medieval technology in the valley.

[previewyoutube=Uz9CzGNN2dM;full][/previewyoutube]

From big things to smaller things: We have repeatedly read about the great desire to be able to further embellish and decorate your own domicile. We want to help you achieve this dream and have created a few new accessories. Your homes in Medieval Dynasty will also be given new shutters and curtains for windows, shelves, vases and much more. 

Nothing stands in the path of upgrading your settlement from beautiful to magnificent.
Speaking of upgrades: The game engine has also been upgraded. From now on, the UE 4.27.2 powers Medieval Dynasty on your PC.

This update is complemented by several bug fixes and improvements.

Tell us in the comments if you like the windmill, where you built it or if you want to challenge it 😊. Of course, feel free to comment on the other features as well! Don't forget to check out our social media channels!
 
Stay safe and see you around

Render Cube and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Third Person View – The first big Roadmap update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Since the 1.0 release of Medieval Dynasty this fall, we are now on the road of adding many more features and functions to the game. This first major update is a “quality-of-life” update in its purest form.

[previewyoutube=tY8yYrLF5IM;full][/previewyoutube]

When playing games in first person view, some of you may experience something called “simulator sickness”. Originally this subset of the motion sickness was discovered when training pilots. Scientists – after researching this sickness – found two plausible theories: a sensory conflict or a postural instability, a balance disorder. Whatever the reason behind, the effects are the same: vertigo, nausea, disorientation, or discomfort. To ensure that everyone can enjoy Medieval Dynasty to the best extent possible, we are now introducing the Third Person View as an optional feature. 

So, whether you are affected by any of the above symptoms or just like to roam around in the Medieval world from a different perspective, we hope you are enjoying this additional feature to the game!

In addition to Third Person Perspective, we have added a much-requested change that is sure to make your heart beat faster! From now on, you can change settings and adjust them during the game! Something that was previously only possible before the start of a new game. You need more power and storage space to transport things? One click and you can pick up as much as you want. You are facing an almost invincible fiend? Quickly increase health points, fight the enemy, and continue playing in a relaxed manner. Now with these new possibilities, you can transform old save games. For example, increase the number of buildings and further expand your city. What do you think? We are listening to your wishes!

See you around!

Here is the link to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1129580/discussions/1/4345408777041476970/]Update Notes[/url].

Village Leaders,

Something spooky is happening in Gostovia. Villages have reported seeing Scarecrows scattered all around the land. Some people report receiving many riches from them, while others are too scared to come close. The people are looking at you, Village Leader. What will you do? Now, let’s see what these people in Gostovia were whispering about...


Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.notes:

[list]
[*] Items sorting in inventory and during trading/transferring.

[*] Custom name for animals	
[*] Key binding now recognizes mouse buttons.	
[*] Checking the size of all saves in saves folder.
[*] Over 40 new random places generated on the map	
[*] Game mode setting for stopping dropped food from spoiling	
[*] Slight camera shakes when using tools or hitting objects

[*] Added option to disable character's breathing in gameplay settings
[*] New dialogue sounds (69 new voice colors): Farewell, first time greeting, Greeting, Vendor
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ce731c2491c0f2391442fc4636b5f8dca5f13368.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Changed the way the achievements are written, this should hopefully lower the possibility of achievement writing fail, which prevented any other achievement to be obtained until the game restarts.	
[*] Waterskin with Water is a lot cheaper than regular waterskin.	
[*] Player can talk to NPC after removing NPC from the village	
[*] Some cases where NPCs sleep on the floor	
[*] Some cases where the workstations work on their own	
[*] Some cases where the NPC gets up from the bench and the player catches him to talk, the NPC runs away	
[*] Racimir can move in with other women without being married to them	
[*] The starting health and damage options don't affect bandits	
[*] Mount no longer spawns from the ground when summoned of assigned to building	
[*] Player is adjusting his rotation properly now when riding on donkey	
[*] Weight of Wooden Vial is too high	
[*] Wooden gate had wrong texture.	
[*] Incorrect warning when placing a Fishing Hut on uneven ground. 	
[*] Wrong setting name for "Korean"	
[*] In some languages text is chopped when giving gift to Females	
[*] Sometimes dismount action key bind is missing	
[*] Wrong expiration time in journal	
[*] Dropped milk when turns to sour milk loses all capacity	
[*] Displayed numbers of potion effects (stamina, food, water) are not correct	
[*] No lighting in door module for residential buildings.	
[*] Clay deposit looks wrong in winter.	
[*] The fruit on the fruit trees did not react to the wind.	
[*] Cases where the AI is unable to enter a building have been reduced.	
[*] NPCs animations sometimes pause when they are standing looking at a bench, chair or workbench, until they finally start interacting
[*] Stubborn horses not walking out from the stable, wanting to cuddle with other horses and do important horse stuff like discussing world domination.
[*] Horses walking really slow in some cases
[*] Foal movement animations do not match their movement speed
[*] Gates have wrong notification when trying to place them in unavailable spot
[*] Dismount action is not assigned to any key after resetting key binds to default.
[*] Items are not assigned to the heir when player transfers to heir on death
[*] Player switch to tool holding pose even though empty quick slot was selected
[*] Transition animations being interrupted causing weird stuttering
[*] Crossbow changing position in player hands when stopping during crouching and aiming
[*] Throwing Rock damage not being affected by the "pull strength"
[*] Rocks attaching to fish when fish is killed.
[*] Player tool animation not being interrupted on season skip
[*] Gates affecting NPCs path preference - they could choose a longer path instead of going through the gate
[*] Bandits floating dead in some cases (What sinister magic was at work here?)
[*] Challenges ending too soon
[*] Once a field has been destroyed by an event, it cannot be re-ploughed.
[*] Ploughing the field when an NPC is collecting resources from them would revert the field to a state as if the resources were just collected
[*] NPC collecting crops from fields (adding to storage) that the player has already collected
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/38afb1f8ffa8671aa495fac9087cbf3fd967f259.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] Head bobbing algorithm improvements	
[*] Snow improvements on bridges, stairs and planks.	
[*] Numerous improvements in post-processing	
[*] The duration of the day has been lengthened and the night shortened.	
[*] The length of the day depends on the season.	
[*] Gates now open wider.	
[*] Gates can now be placed on player's roads.	
[*] Further animal IK improvements	
[*] Quests now can be untracked (Chapters cannot be untracked)	
[*] If text in options will be too long, then there will be sliding animation	
[*] Equipped or assigned items will not be taken from player in deliver quests	
[*] Sorting now sorts all items together without division to categories	
[*] Updated system for key binding, now it's possible to change bound key for every action. 
[*] Quickslots for some keyboard layouts now must be remapped manually in key bind menu
[*] Removed odd white lines in scroll bars	
[*] Rendering optimizations
[*] Horse animation transitions are now smoother while accelerating
[*] Time left for objective is now not visible if objective is done
[*] Seasons left for quest to complete is now not visible if quest is completed or failed
[*] Default framerate set to 60
[*] Improved snapping NPCs to interaction points
[*] Turn in place animation speed and angles
[*] Throwable rock damage changed to 5 instead of 10
[*] German updated	
[*] Polish updated	
[*] Dutch updated	
[*] Swedish updated	
[*] Russian updated 
[/list]

notes.title: Important Announcement - Early Access Saves on 1.0 Full Release Day
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

We have some important information regarding Medieval Dynasty 1.0 Full Release and your current save files. Some of you asked us what will happen with the game saves from the Early Access version of the game once Medieval Dynasty enters the 1.0 state. Well, the answer is a bit complicated, so sit back, grab a cup of tea or coffee, and read through all the info that you need to know.

Since we are adding new storylines, fixes, new characters, changes to the map, and more to Medieval Dynasty, your current saves may not function properly from Early Access to the 1.0 version. However, we have three options/workarounds that you might want to take a look at before the full release occurs.

[b]Option 1: [/b]

Download the 1.0 Full Release update and enjoy your new medieval experience from the beginning. However, this time around you will be able to take part in a new and extended storyline. On your way to creating a successful dynasty, you will meet new people, get access to all new additions and features that will come along with the 1.0 release, experience exciting twists, and go on new quests. It’s experiencing Medieval Dynasty in all its glory.


[b]Option 2:[/b]

This option is for all Village Leaders who don’t want to start from scratch. For all of you who wish to continue your villages as they are, we will create a separate game branch on Steam so that you can enjoy and grow your already built dynasties. You will not lose your saves and you can continue to develop your villages exactly as before. This branch will support Medieval Dynasty version 0.6.0.5. Keep in mind though, if you choose this option, you will miss out on the new content that will be added with the 1.0 Full Release. If this is not a dealbreaker for you, this might be an option for you. 

[b]Option 3:[/b]

If you don’t want to miss out on your previous work and you want to enjoy new content, this workaround might be for you. You can load your Early Access save file with Medieval Dynasty’s 1.0 version. If you do that, most of the new content should work properly. However, some problems may occur. Due to changes to the map and environment, you may find your village is floating in the air or be stuck in the ground or under water. You may also find problems with quest givers, npcs, and other characters. In rare cases, you might find a bandit’s camp in your village. Keep in mind though that with this workaround, the new storyline and quests will not be available. If this is something you don't mind and you are ok with possible errors and mistakes, then this option is for you.

[b]Please note that you can copy/store saves in a different portion of your hard drive, so they’re safe, just in case something goes awry with the original save game! [/b]

We know how much time you invested in this game and how much effort you put into your villages. And we know that these workarounds may not be 100% what you were looking for, but we feel that a new, improved storyline with more quests and characters is worth the effort. We also tested out and tried to find as many solutions for you as well, so we hope that some of these workarounds are an option that you’ll be happy with and let you continue your medieval journey. 

If you have any questions, write to us in the comment section below. We are here for you. And we can't wait for you to see Medieval Dynasty in it’s full version. We’re as excited for it as you are.


Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #5!
notes.notes:
Welcome Village Leaders,

Our 5th Medieval Dynasty Roadmap Update is ready for you to download! But before you return to your village, have a read on the latest additions that just came to the game. 

[previewyoutube=QHwbwyWum8E;full][/previewyoutube]

First new addition - relationships. There is nothing better in life than a happy and strong marriage. Unfortunately, to get there, there is a winding and bumpy road to cross called flirting. From now on, you have more verbal opportunities at your disposal to win the heart of your chosen one. A compliment, a joke, a fun fact, a gossip, or the good old power of poetry - use them all to attract the attention of your lady. To strengthen your chances a little, you can also give your chosen one something special, a gift that will steal her heart you might say. As you gain experience, more options will be available to you in the art of flirting. So don’t wait, go out and meet some people! There’s someone out there for everyone.

If you are looking for that special gift, the exotic goods Vendors are the people with those unique and precious items which you can use as presents. Stay alert, as they will appear in random taverns at different seasons.

Next up are Shops and Vendors. You can now set up your own Market Stall and sell goods of your choice. And if you are in need to be somewhere else, don’t worry, all you have to do is assign a villager, he or she will take care of your place, and the business keeps going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/5b9d3bb4240e818c09044b979f43a935063aec01.jpg[/img]

[i]Set up a Market Stall and earn that extra money.[/i]

Also with this update we’ve added a new animal which lives in the forest - the lynx. Watch out though as this isn't a nice kitty that you want to hang out with. He is wild and dangerous. But don’t worry, we’ve got your back. With a brand-new wooden crossbow at your disposal, you don’t have to be worried too much about it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/02768c06a708a62cd637bab1c171b03ff70ce2a0.jpg[/img]

Lynx - a little kitten that can cause a lot of trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/7c37216f8b9a749bd649436c7dab10d0e005f8d2.jpg[/img]

Wooden crossbow - a new weapon for your arsenal. 

We don't want to keep you away from your settlement, so go and enjoy the new additions! We, on the other hand, will be watching the comments to see what your thoughts are.

If you want to find out all the details about this update, read the changelog below. And don’t forget to share your thoughts!


Until next time,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #4!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

The time has come! The update is here! Here is the next Medieval Dynasty Roadmap Major Update. This time, we’ve added new resources, new tools and activities, a hairy new companion, and a whole lot of fixes and optimizations. Let’s take a look at all the additions in more detail.

It’s hard to imagine the growth of a community without proper resources. From now on in addition to iron, now you can also dig copper and tin. You will find copper and tin in caves, and these deposits are easy to reach. To find iron though, you have to dig a little bit deeper, into the caves themselves. To get access to their depths, you will need to build mines. Down below is the home to the valuable iron ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/302acf9300697af4448040acb798b94c33e16f3d.jpg[/img]
[i]Just a few more hits, and we’ll be there.[/i]

After collecting those precious ores, you, or your people, can take them back to your village smithy. The blacksmith will smelt the raw tin and copper ores into tin and copper bars, which you can then combine and create the coveted bronze bars. Iron is a simpler process - you can convert iron ores straight into iron bars. Use these valuable bars to create a whole new range of copper and bronze tools and weapons, such as hammers, sickles, knives, bolts, arrows and more. 

As you can see there is a whole new underground world with hidden treasures waiting to be discovered by you.

We also added a new model of transportation - a donkey. He is slower than your old friend, the trusty horse, but he can carry more stuff than his bigger cousin. And he’s also cheaper. The perfect value-for-money companion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a1c8786e00d1f65a342bc111ac634398e44c63e8.jpg[/img]
[i]Your new steed, sire![/i]

But that’s not all that you will get in this update. Take some time off from your everyday tasks, venture out, and visit Tutki. This is the place you can find and buy a donkey. We have also added a whole lot of fixes and other updates too. One of them is a change in buying and selling prices. From now on all selling prices will be higher and buying prices will be lower. See the changelog for all the details. And one last thing! From now on all our Dutch, Chinese, and Swedish fans can enjoy their medieval experience in their own languages.

Let us know what you think about this Major update below. Write down your thoughts in the comments section. What is the first thing you will do in the new update? We’re curious to hear your answers. And as always, don’t be shy, stay in touch, and follow us on our Social Media Channels.


All the best,

Your Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #3!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

With calendar spring now in its second week, it is a bit symbolic that our 3rd major Medieval Dynasty Update arrives at around the same time. This update brings a lot of new features, mechanics, updates, fixes, and heaps more. But let us start with what a lot of you have been waiting for. New building types, professions, and products.

[previewyoutube=8eMQ5-rWmU0;full][/previewyoutube]

First up, alcohol. In the middle ages, alcohol was a highly valued commodity. Not only did it provide “entertainment” to the people, but it was also treated as a medicine. In some places, access to clean water was not an option. So, what do you do when you are thirsty? Well, have a quick gulp of some beer or wine of course! With that short history lesson out of the way, here is our first new feature - the ability to produce alcohol. You now have access to a new type of field, the Orchards, and you can plant new trees and plants, such as apple trees, cherries, plums, hops, and more. And once the plants come bearing fruit, you will be able to pick them, and with the newly added Brewing Station and Wine Barrels, turn them into beer, wine, ciders and even juices (variety is the spice of life as they say). You can of course keep the alcohol for yourself and your people or turn it into profit. That decision is all up to you - just do not drink it all yourself as the consequences will be a bit hazy and painful.  

Next up, we have beekeeping. This is a feature that a few of us in the office have been excited the most about simply because we adore those little buzzing creatures. You will now be able to build Apiaries in your village, a dedicated place for your beehives and your honeybees. You will be able to produce honey, which can be collected by your beekeepers, a highly valuable commodity which will help you create honeycomb and mead - the nectar of gods. This building will certainly get you buzzing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/20e1ed4776c4fb3e2128d780bfe23aa544e0eed2.jpg[/img]
[i]Collecting that sweet nectar.
[/i]
Another new building that we have added is the Workshop. Inside this building, you’ll be able to place workbenches where you or other skilled craftsmen can make, create, and operate the above-mentioned Brewing Stations, Wine Barrels, as well as manufacture clay pots and bottles using the Pottery Wheel, and make non-alcoholic juice using the Juice Press. This building is your non-stop shop for all those essential needs to make your medieval community thrive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/34827f75bd3a505dff830d384321b6199436184d.jpg[/img]
[i]Crafting in progress.[/i]

Another noticeable addition is new food that is available to you and your people, such as different types of porridges, tarts, rolls, eggs, and soups. We have also added eight new talents (for Farming, Extraction, Survival, Hunting, and Diplomacy), new animations, and we’ve increased the building limit too. Plus, lots and lots more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/052979de6553bb392603181f11ab3e93808d09c9.jpg[/img]
[i]A feast fit for a Lord.[/i]

We hope that you enjoy this latest update and do let us know what you think of it too in the comments below. To see all the changes, we have added a full Changelog a few paragraphs down below. And as always, let us know your thoughts, suggestions, ideas, and anything else either on our social channels or on our Discord server. And come by the r/MedievalDynasty Community on Reddit too. They are a friendly bunch of people (hello!!).

All the best

Toplitz Productions and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #2!
notes.notes:
Hello Village Leaders,

Say hello to our second Medieval Dynasty Major Update. This time you will get brand new features, new buildings, and changes to the mechanics of the game. So, let us get to know all of these additions a little better.

Let us start with your new companion - the horse. This trusty fellow will get you on his back, wherever you wish to. Not only will you get to your destination point with your best friend, but also you will get there faster. Isn’t that convenient? Your horse is equipped with a special backpack with which you can carry more staff to trade and sell. But do not forget about your horse’s needs. He needs some rest and good food after a hard day's work. You can take care of him at the new building - the stable. So make sure you will get one, before you get your new four-legged friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/f6de5525aaaaa0ca032b0d5b3d2ea891eaea9cc8.jpg[/img]
[i]The Stable - home for your horse companion.[/i]

Our next addition is all about the farming animals. From now on your animals can reproduce. Keep them happy, in good shape, and they will pay you off with a precious little baby. Just imagine how much your farms can grow. Not to mention that it is a great way to save your hard-earned money.

Also on the menu: challenges! Spice up your town life by accepting a challenge here and there!

Finally - building limits. Thanks to a lot of optimization work, we can push our 30-building limit to a new level. With this update you can place up to 40 buildings in your village. Your settlement can be bigger than ever before. 

These are just some of the features that you will get with this second Medieval Dynasty Major Update. To find out all the details, read our changelog below.


Until next time.

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

[h1]Change Log to v.0.3.0.2.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad5a520ff892afe53d94d369ed41191b6caac6ef.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New building - Stable.
[*] New animal - Horse.
[*] New feature - Horse Riding.
[*] New gameplay features - Challenges and Kings.
[*] New game character - Herald. An NPC distributing challenges.
[*] New harvesting tools - Stone Sickle and Iron Sickle.

notes.title: Medieval Dynasty - Major Roadmap Update #1!
notes.notes:
Hello Tribe Leaders, 

The day has finally come and the moment is finally here. The first big Medieval Dynasty’s content drop has arrived! So let’s get straight into what you are getting.

One of the major new additions are Events. As we explained in our last week’s teaser update, they are an extra layer to the gameplay. You will be faced with many scenarios that can play out depending on how you deal with them. One day, you might have to deal with heavy rains that damaged your crops, while a few months later your people might get a significant boost because the joy of Spring can be felt in the air. These events can have a major impact on your game and will test your wits and leadership tact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/16db18555570178fff68e778d2ee2cb0930c52a8.png[/img]

[i]Tough decisions are ahead of you...[/i]

Events are not all that you will find in this update. As many of you requested we added some decorative items to the game. You can finally bring light to your quaint village by creating torches and lanterns. Not only will they provide light, but they’ll also add a bit of warmth too in those cold winter nights. We’ve also added furniture, so your people can have a place to sit and eat by, and we’ve added other little decorative items as well. All of this so that you can add your personal touch to your village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/51aa98dd2b9813bdd247d883681d280f8f86f866.jpg[/img]

[i]Lanterns will brighten up your nights.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/aa63a330fd29ce233b35f39632f6fa1c6e0566af.jpg[/img]

[i]Some new furniture for your tribe.[/i]

We’ve also made your life a little bit easier too. Now you can carry a lot more on you and your shoulders thanks to the new pouches and bags. They will help you with all the heavy lifting and make your trips to other villages more efficient and lucrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/74d1890e39986277cbc441ed5d53bc55333d1b71.jpg[/img]

[i]Your new bag collection[/i]

We’ve also heard your requests to have customizable gameplay options. You can now play around and adjust such setting as the number of days per season, the tax multiplier, give yourself unlimited health, food, water, and more. A lot of you wanted to be able to play around with these options and play the game you wanted – we hope this is exactly what you were looking for.

These are just some of the major changes that we brought into the Medieval Dynasty world. For a full list, take a look at our changelog below. Let us know what you think of these new additions too. And as always, follow us on Facebook and Twitter for all the latest updates (and a big shout out to our r/MedievalDynasty Reddit community!). Remember, this update is just the beginning. 


Until next time. 

Your Toplitz and Render Cube Teams

notes.title: Production Update - Dependencies of the seasons and your environment - July 2020
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

With a new month upon us, it’s time that we take a step back, and take you behind the production curtain in our latest Medieval Dynasty Production Update. This time we want to show you more about the survival aspect of this game, specifically on how the seasons will impact you, your tribe, and the world around. We will share some tips which will help you plan your actions, as the more you know, the better the chance that you and your tribe will survive. 

Let’s start with dependencies of the seasons. Each of the four seasons of the year has their own unique conditions which impact on you and your work. This is really important if you want to start cultivation. Before you start farming you have to remember that not only each plant has to be seeded at the right time of the year - you can only harvest it at the right time of the year too. Pretty much, we can’t sow in the wrong season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/a5c291a8bacedfe54ffecc5f3c0201a7931b5870.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/60fc0606e037f757c758ba87d3ed8fa5972462cc.jpg[/img]

[i]Fields with people working on it.[/i]

Winter is governed by its own laws. Because of the low temperatures, it is impossible to cultivate the land. Therefore, you have to gather enough food to survive this difficult time. You also have to remember that for your people to survive, food will need to be stored in a special food storage building. So make sure that you plan your food supply chain well. If you don’t, you’re opening yourself up for a disaster.

Another important element you should pay special attention to are animals. There are 14 different types of wild and farm animals in the game. They are not only an additional source of food, but their fur also makes for great clothing, which will be definitely a good barrier against low temperatures. Farm animals can be expensive, but they are with no doubt worth their investment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/9b42290b50d3582dd76e2c07f965adf130355e4e.jpg[/img]

[i]One of the Medieval Dynasty farm animals - the cow.[/i]


So, as you can see, you have to keep your eyes open all the time to reach and use all the opportunities which will help you survive in this raw and harsh land. 

And finally, we have some new shots of the world itself. Take a look at the land which will be your new home in the not so distant future. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/2f94adfe12dbc30f80b73f77b1480b10f6562f33.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/ad51882efd46f6910aff38e96f616eac19c357fc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/1269cd79173068292241af82a08fd911673d8e71.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/04d766ef1f8940c7e70d77798273f2a1be4cf07d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/1c366607e4343d113d326934087b4469889fcfd6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/73ba3406dc52ee72bcbbed3a53112a78421c4256.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/05f79b3a6a05f29726de00e54ada93e62555b68f.jpg[/img]

[I]Some of the environments in the Medieval Dynasty.[/i]


We hope that you’re enjoying the updates that we are sharing with you, and as always, write all your thoughts and questions in the comment section below. We love hearing your feedback and suggestions. And if there’s anything that you would like us to talk about specifically, write it down below!


Stay vigilant and until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Production Update - Animals, Plants and Clothes - June 2020
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

It’s time for our next Medieval Dynasty Production Update. Today, we want to show you some of the things that we worked on recently over the last month. We also have some screenshots and images to go along with the update too, which we think will interest you the most. But let’s not prolong any further - let’s get into it!

Let’s start with some visual aspects of the game. Recently we added a variety of different versions of farm animals. There will be male, female, and baby animals. So far, we have sheep, goats, and pigs, but we are planning other farm animals too. And as a side note, there is nothing cuter than baby animals ;). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/682b4b1de2e3d153ff4adef6132eac9d41284b9a.png[/img]

[i]Versions of farm animals.[/i]


Now that we have animals covered, let’s move onto people. As you can see from the above image, our humble man needed some clothing. Not only to be appropriate but also so he won’t freeze during winter. Recently, we spent some time on creating new clothes for our medieval people. Before we started the process, we spent many hours researching historical sources and try to understand what type of clothing people wore in those days. After all, we want our game to be as authentic as possible. After collecting a large number of historical references, we were able to get down to work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/345feef105772e4ac73b6ff1bea72cc8760623d1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/09fa671b2eb2c56598fcd0f6d7405218c5ada719.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/1ba3c8ea7f3c11e8d0791e106f3567ac8d455eb5.png[/img]


[i]A small sample of the different clothes you will see in Medieval Dynasty.[/i]


While remaining on the subject of visuals, we can mention the changes we have made to the environment itself. We added more environment models, such as bushes and crops. We have created a variety of plant types that are specific to the environment too. We will have specific plants that are present in wetlands, mountain areas, forests, and meadows. We also made sure that they can change during the seasons as well. We also created various types of crops too - take a look at some of them below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/0fb54c15eddc227c0dd72520382db2c4b782e9f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/d2fa9c649ec4cbf3bd5d283b3118055de431b37d.png[/img]


[i]Some of the environments with their characteristic plants.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/36aee081bd618966235a351e988ccb0e91fa2a5b.png[/img]

[i]Different kinds of crops.[/i]


These are just some of the things we worked on recently. We also worked on some quests, buildings, vendors, and more. We hope you enjoyed this update and it gave you a bit more information on Medieval Dynasty is all about. And as always, send us your thoughts and questions in the comment section below. 

Stay safe and until next time,

Toplitz Team

notes.title: Production Update - Aging process, buildings and survival
notes.notes:
Welcome Tribe Leader,

Every day, our game is taking shape and it’s becoming a bit more complete. Today, we wanted to share with you a few of the many things we've been working on over the last month or so. We hope you will find them interesting. So let's not prolong anymore. Let’s get to it.

One of the things we've been polishing are the looks of our characters. To give the feeling that your settlement is growing older and that time doesn’t stay still, we added an aging process to our characters. Not only will you see the aging process happen on character faces, but also their hair will change colour, getting greyer as time goes on. It’s a little detail that we think will make the game feel more realistic, and it’ll help you bond with the characters as well. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/26cff811079ecfcc4c13bef8b894622b387e9ac7.jpg[/img]

[i]Aging process in action. Same character, over a span of a lifetime. [/i]

While we’re on the topic of visuals, we took some time this month to refine the look of the buildings. They now have undergone a small renovation and have new foundations. And it’s not only the outside that changes. We've added new stairs as well, so you can access those higher-up places in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/3a65db93487b4dee1ba4998f11f0a0c4dcbaac15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/15795d55e2c2b5352c0c5d1fb40ad839a632a16a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35668477/30d485e778c69f5360bf7be48d6e7a99dce01dd3.jpg[/img]

[i]Some of the buildings from your settlement. A Barn that needs fixing, a Hunting Lodge, and a House.[/i]

Finally, a little bit about our work on survival mechanics. We've added some elements to the game that we feel will make it more interesting. Life in the Middle Ages was not easy. There were many dangers waiting for people at every turn. The cold of winter was especially dangerous - you need to find a way to survive in harsh conditions. We've worked a lot on temperature mechanics and the role they play in the overall gameplay. And as silly as this little feature might sound, we worked on our campfires too! Fire will bring relief to frozen hands, but you have to be careful because if you get to close, it will hurt you. 

Apart from the mentioned topics above we have - as always - further improved and added overall gameplay elements, performance and stability.

We hope that this update gave you a bit of insight into what Medieval Dynasty is shaping up to be (of course, without revealing too much). By the way, if you want more info, videos, screenshots, and more, you can find it on our social channels. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Discord Server. 

Let us know what you thought of our update, and stay safe - not just in the game, but outside of it as well. We hope you’re well and healthy. 


Until next time,

Toplitz Team
